title: Germany walk-discovery candidates — direct research pass 1
purpose: 100 Germany candidates selected for the experience of unexpectedly encountering them on foot. This is a reviewable editorial research batch, not a production import.
selection_rules: visible or meaningfully legible from public space
one concise architectural, industrial, historical or human hook
works as part of an ordinary walk rather than only as a ticketed destination
avoids generic headline attractions unless the exterior or surrounding urban fabric independently earns inclusion
geographically distributed across major and secondary cities
research_method: reviewed the repository data model and existing authored-place tone
used official tourism, monument, industrial-heritage and local-history source families to shape the candidate sweep
used community recommendations and unusual-place roundups as discovery leads, not final factual authority
filtered for immediate visual legibility, compact story value, walkability and shareability
kept all claims and novelty status provisional until production verification
production_gate: exact and fuzzy duplicate check against data/spots.json
verify current survival, access and public visibility
verify every factual claim against authoritative Germany and local sources
resolve an existing Ci city or region slug and exact ne category
add coordinates, area, postcode, unique id and bbox validation
fact-check and rewrite in final owner voice without overwriting authored live entries
run npm build and all repository validation checks before any production merge
research_caveat: The repository connector does not expose a reliable full-text index of the complete 14,902-place catalogue. Candidate novelty is therefore intentionally marked pending rather than overstated.
